why: A single-author arXiv preprint (2001.10956, originally 2020, revised through Nov 2025) claims to prove the Ramanujan-Petersson conjecture for Maass forms of SL(2,Z), but it predates the snapshot and is still unaccepted/unverified, so it's unclear whether the Nov 2025 revision represents genuine post-snapshot movement or just an old contested claim being resubmitted; the mathematical community still treats the Maass forms case as open.
queries: Ramanujan-Petersson conjecture Maass forms SL(2,Z) proof November 2025 arXiv

found.title: The Ramanujan-Petersson and Selberg conjectures for Maass forms
